Karnataka Health Minister Dinesh Gundurao reassures the public about the two detected #HMPV cases in Bengaluru.

He explained that HMPV is just one of the many respiratory viruses, accounting for around 1% of flu-like illnesses. It's a common occurrence with no fatalities. https://t.co/HZevQKx5dY
